description: This header file declares APIs for managing MTA (Multimedia Terminal Adapter) settings in a TR-181 data model context, including functions for getting, setting, validating, committing, and rolling back parameters related to MTA and MTA v6, as well as logs and optional battery information. It defines interfaces for interacting with data model objects and their attributes, primarily for use in a C-based implementation.
